name: TextRuns
lead: Words wherever the API shows them: a string, or a table of runs. A table's entries are its runs in order (each a string or another table), and its named fields are the style of all of them; a run that names its own style keeps it. See "text" in docs/luau-api.md.

fields.name: color
fields.description: The colour of every run that does not pick its own: a colour value, a name or hex.

fields.name: bold
fields.description: Bold for every run that does not say otherwise.

fields.name: italic
fields.description: Italic for every run that does not say otherwise.

fields.name: underline
fields.description: Underlined for every run that does not say otherwise.

fields.name: strike
fields.description: Struck through for every run that does not say otherwise.

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Called for every letter, every frame the text is on screen: hands back how that letter looks, or nil to leave it.

title: TextRuns type
